function.name: get_dominant_trait
function.description: Calculate the dominant genetic trait of an organism based on its genetic makeup. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

allele1.description: The first allele of the organism.

allele2.description: The second allele of the organism.

inheritance_pattern.description: The type of inheritance pattern (could be dominant, recessive, or co-dominant). Default is 'dominant'.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the frequency of gene variant rs7412 in the European population?" They want allele frequency. We need to provide the frequency. According to known data, rs7412 is APOE gene variant. In Europeans, allele frequency of rs7412 (C allele) is about 0.10? Actually APOE has alleles ε2, ε3, ε4. rs7412 is C allele associated with ε2. Frequency of ε2 allele in Europeans ~0.07-0.10. Let's check typical values: In 1000 Genomes European populations, rs7412 allele frequency: For CEU (Utah residents with Northern and Western European ancestry), allele frequency of C allele is about 0.08. For TSI (Toscani in Italy) maybe 0.09. So overall European frequency ~0.08-0.10. Provide approximate frequency: around 8-10%. Provide source: 1000 Genomes Project, gnomAD. Provide explanation.
